translation: The extraordinary meridians number eight vessels in all: they are not constrained or controlled by the twelve regular channels and have no interior-exterior pairing, and so they are called extraordinary. This is because the regular channels are like ditches and canals, whereas the extraordinary meridians are like lakes and marshes; when the qi of the regular channels is vigorous and full, it then overflows into the extraordinary meridians. Therefore Qin Yueren compared it: when heavenly rain descends, the ditches and canals overflow and fill, pouring out in a driving torrent, flowing into the lakes and marshes — this brings out the secret purport that the Ling and Su [jing] had not yet revealed.
